senses.gloss:
ITA-7.1.4.26 aratniḥ अरत्निः
Distance between elbow and tip of little finger
Measure of length equal to the distance between the elbow and the tip of the little finger: 16.5 inches or 41.91 cm, approximately equivalent to 22 aṅgula.

ITA-9.6.58 ārāśastram आराशस्त्रम्
Sharp-pointed instrument (awl)
A sharp-tipped instrument with a notch at the tip used for piercing.
